core_memory.user_lifestyle: I'm in my mid-50s now, and I've realized that little lifestyle changes make a huge difference. Living in Kansas means dealing with unpredictable weather, so my routine has to be flexible. I try to stay active, eat right, and manage my stress levels. It's all about balance!
